features.title: Local SQLite Caching, API, and Repository for Comments
features.description: Implement Room entity `NoteBlockCommentEntity` and DAO `NoteBlockCommentDao`. Hook it to `AppDatabase`. Add comment endpoints `listNoteBlockComments` and `createNoteBlockComment` to `NotesApiService`. Implement `NoteCommentRepository` and `NoteCommentRepositoryImpl` to handle fetch-caching and create-posting of block comments. Write JVM Unit & Integration tests for DAO and Repository.
features.user_visible_behavior: Comments are saved and fetched locally, enabling seamless offline capabilities.
verification: Run unit tests to verify comments entity, database migrations, and repository fetch/caching logic: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests com.example.notesapp.data.repository.NoteCommentRepositoryTest`

features.title: Editor Bottom Bar Integration and Discussion Bottom Sheet
features.description: Add comment button to editor default bottom bar. Enable text block comments tracking in NoteEditorViewModel. Implement DiscussionBottomSheet showing drag handle, close button, focused text block content preview with a yellow vertical accent bar, a scrollable list of comments for the active block, and a comment input box with avatar, static attachments, mentions trigger button, and circular send button. Integrate ViewModel to read/write comments.
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can click a text block, tap the comment button to view existing comments in a stylized bottom sheet, and submit a new comment.
verification: Run Instrumented UI tests to verify that the comment button launches the sheet, renders the focused block context with a yellow bar, and inserts a comment upon clicking send: `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest --tests com.example.notesapp.ui.editor.DiscussionSheetUiTest`
evidence: 3 instrumented Compose UI tests passed successfully on 2026-06-01 07:50 (connectedDebugAndroidTest exit code 0).
features.notes: Ensures full Composable visual fidelity matching the provided mockup.

features.title: @ Mentions Autocomplete Suggestion Popup
features.description: Implement floating autocomplete popup trigger when typing `@` or clicking the `@` button in the comment field. Populate dates with predefined calculations (Today, Tomorrow, Next Tuesday 3pm). Populate users with note collaborators from NoteShareRepository + note owner. Populate notes by querying local notes from NoteRepository matching query text. Tapping a suggestion auto-inserts the plain-text/date mention into the cursor position in the comment text field.
features.user_visible_behavior: A user typing @ inside the comment box sees a popup with collaborators, dates, and related notes, and tapping a suggestion auto-fills the text field.
verification: Run Instrumented UI tests to verify mentions trigger, list rendering for users, dates, and notes, and correct completion behavior on click: `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest --tests com.example.notesapp.ui.editor.MentionsAutocompleteTest`
features.notes: Translates ISO date/timestamps to friendly strings upon rendering.
